text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good morning. I take it you've got work today, as well?
...Is the sun always this bright?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン？　
おはよう。
今日もお仕事？
……
なんだか太陽が眩しいね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wait.
This isn't sunlight...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ううん、
こんなに眩しいなんてありえない。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: That's it! It's the strange light from a while back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この光、
たしか前にも……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
The bell hasn't rung yet, has it?
I wouldn't mind taking a look over the test questions before we start.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──まだチャイム鳴ってないよね……？
小テストの範囲、
最後まで見直しておきたいんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Oh, there it is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
鳴っちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'll check over the qu—
Hmm?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは問題を見て……
あれ？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Does {0} not have an eraser?
It looks that way, at least.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……間違いない。
{0}くん、
消しゴムがないみたい。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could help,
but we're in the middle of a test. I don't want to get yelled at...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとかしてあげたいな……
でもテスト中だし、
先生に見つかったら怒られちゃう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wait. No.
I need to stop thinking like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……違う。
こんな考え方じゃだめ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
If {0} was in my position, he'd help them out.
That's the sort of person he is!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんならきっと、
困ってる人を見たら、
貸してあげるはず……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.orig_text: ねぇ、{0}くん……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: You need an eraser, right? Use this one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もし良かったらこれ……
使って。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Shhh...
Here you go. Just make sure we don't get caught, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しーっ……
……はい。
先生にバレないように、
静かに受け取ってね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry about me.
I've got another one.
choice_data_list: Thanks. Good luck on the test.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしのことは気にしないで。
消しゴムならもう一つあるから。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks. You too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
テスト、
頑張ってね……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.orig_text: 良かった……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute.
Did I... Did I just give him the one I normally use?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？
今渡したのって、
いつもわたしが使ってるほう……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh no. Ohhh no! This is bad.
This is really bad!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど……
どうしよう！
あっちには、
あっちの消しゴムには……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: That's the one I wrote his name on!
text_block_list.orig_text: 好きな人の名前を書いちゃってるんだった……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I saw that post online about writing the name of the person
you like on your eraser and just... went with the flow, then forgot about it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
前にネットの占いを信じて書いちゃったの、
すっかり忘れてたよ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It's my eraser, so he'll be weirded out if he sees his name on it.
No doubt about it... I need to do something, and fast!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしの消しゴムなのに、
自分の名前が書いてあるのが分かったら
絶対変に思われちゃう……
なんとかしなきゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, {0}.
Do you, uh, mind if we switch erasers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん……
あのね……
消しゴムを、
取り替えて欲しいの。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Look, this one's a lot better.
choice_data_list: It's okay. This one works just fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
こっちの方が消しやすいよ……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
The eraser might be okay, 
b-but I'm certainly not...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫！？
……わ、
わたしが大丈夫じゃないの……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Uh oh. We'll get noticed if I raise my voice like that.
Urgh, why did I have to lend him that one?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ以上声を大きくしたら先生に気づかれる……
どうしてあっちの消しゴムを貸しちゃったんだろう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Nooo!
Don't look under the sleeve!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だめーっ！
中は見ないでーっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh... So much for not raising my voice.
Here comes the scolding and test retakes...
Oh well, though. It was worth it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ……
大声出しちゃった……
これじゃあ先生に怒られて再テストだよ……
……でも見られなくて良かったぁ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
So, how'd you like that little present?
Bet it was a nice little dream for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしからのプレゼントはどうだった？
ちゃんといい『夢』見られた？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I gotta say, though. You really are a turbo dunce, aren't you?
You should work on fixing that someday,
otherwise you'll be in for some real trouble down the line.
text_block_list.orig_text:
以前のあんたとユイの記憶を元に作った『夢』なんだけど……
鈍感なのもほどほどにしとかないと、
いつか痛い目見るわよ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: That's enough for today, though. Catch you later. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね～♪

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
Did it happen again?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んん……
またあの夢……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight... Well, I guess we both had the same dream again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン……
また、
同じ夢を見てたんだね、
わたしたち……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I shouldn't have raised my voice like that.
What was that thing called? An eraser?
I guess I didn't want you to see what was written on it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね。
いきなりあんな大声……
あの消しゴム？　
っていうものの中は、
絶対に見られたくなかったの……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
What did it say?
Sorry, I don't really remember.
All I know is I didn't want anyone, you included, to see it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何が書いてあったのかは……
ごめんなさい。
わたしもぼんやりとしか覚えてなくて……
とにかく見られたくないって気持ちは、
確かだったの。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...
It was his name written on it, but there's no way I can tell him that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううぅ……
あなたの名前です、
なんて言えるわけないよ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
That's a good idea for a charm, though.
Maybe I'll try it out for real.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あのおまじない、
わたしもやってみようかな。
